headline: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola, and Dell Object to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Plan
summary: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola, and Dell objected to a plan by OKX and ICE to trade tokenized versions of their shares. Nearly half of the venture's original roster of companies has now rejected the blockchain trading venue.
why: Intercontinental Exchange operates major stock exchanges globally, while OKX is a large crypto venue. Corporate resistance to unauthorized equity tokenization highlights ongoing legal and regulatory barriers for blockchain asset venues.
